newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's ONIC cuts wheat, maize export targets.
newsitem.headline: France's ONIC cuts wheat, maize export targets.

text.p: French cereals office ONIC on Wednesday confirmed a sharp reduction in its forecasts for soft wheat and maize exports to countries outside the European Union during the 1996/97 campaign.
The agency reduced its forecast for soft wheat commercial grain exports to non-EU countries to 6.0 million tonnes from last month's target of 6.8 million.
ONIC slashed its estimate for maize exports to countries outside the European Union to 250,000 tonnes from a previous forecast range of 250,000 to 1.25 million tonnes.

In its November report, released ahead of its monthly news conference, ONIC also cut its estimate for barley exports to countries outside the European Union to 1.2 million tonnes from a previous estimate of 1.5 million.
France exported 3.75 million tonnes of soft wheat, 221,000 tonnes of barley and 164,000 tonnes of maize to non-EU destinations in 1995/96.
ONIC raised its estimate for soft wheat exports to the rest of the European Union to 8.84 million tonnes from the 8.30 million forecast last month and the 8.613 million exported in the past season.

It also revised up its estimate for barley exports to other EU countries to 2.1 million tonnes from the 1.98 million forecast last month. This would compare with 2.244 million tonnes exported in 1995/96.
ONIC marginally raised its forecast for maize exports to other EU countries to 5.62 million tonnes from last month's 5.60 million. This would compare with 6.087 million tonnes exported in 1995/96.
ONIC made little changes to its forecasts for the 1996 wheat, barley and maize crops.
It said the 1996 wheat crop might have jumped to a record 34.35 million tonnes from 29.83 million last year.
The barley crop was put at 9.47 million tonnes against 7.74 million tonnes in 1995.
ONIC now sees the 1996 maize crop at 13.62 million tonnes against 12.39 million in 1995.
The report also suggests France might end the 1996/97 season with a soft wheat carryover of 2.297 million tonnes against the 2.127 million forecast last month and 2.230 million on June 30, 1996.
It put the barley carryover at 1.285 million tonnes against 1.089 million last month and 629,000 tonnes on June 30, 1996.
ONIC is targeting a maize carryover of 2.741 million tonnes against last month's forecast of a carryover ranging from two to three million tonnes.
France ended the previous season with a maize carryover of 1.653 million tonnes.
